parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：50，默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the endpoint group. Valid values:

default: a default endpoint group.

virtual: a virtual endpoint group.

If you omit this parameter, the operation returns all default and virtual endpoint groups
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点组类型。取值：

default：默认终端节点组。
virtual：虚拟终端节点组。
空值：表示查询所有默认终端节点组和虚拟终端节点组
parameters.name: endpoint_group_type

parameters.help_en:
Whether to enable the access log. Valid values:

on: enables the access log.

off (default): disables the access log
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问日志。取值：
on：开启访问日志。
off（默认值）：关闭访问日志
parameters.name: access_log_switch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters long and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的标签键。
一旦输入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

最多支持64个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签键
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters long and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, or contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
终端节点组的标签值。一旦输入该值，可以为空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。

最多支持输入20个标签值
fields.name: value

Specifies whether to preserve client IP addresses.

true: Client IP preservation is enabled.

false: Client IP preservation is disabled

是否开启了自动获取方式开启保持客户端源 IP 功能。

false：未开启保持客户端源IP功能

EnableProxyProtocol.description_en:
Specifies whether to use Proxy Protocol to preserve client IP addresses.

true: Proxy Protocol is enabled.

false: Proxy Protocol is disabled
EnableProxyProtocol.description_zh:
是否使用ProxyProtocol方式开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

true：使用ProxyProtocol方式开启了保持客户端源IP功能。

false：未使用ProxyProtocol方式开启保持客户端源IP功能

tcp：TCP协议

The type of endpoint. Valid values:

Domain: a custom domain name.

Ip: a custom IP address.

IpTarget: a custom private IP address.

PublicIp: an Alibaba Cloud public IP address.

ECS: an Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.

SLB: an Alibaba Cloud SLB instance.

ALB: an Alibaba Cloud ALB instance.

OSS: an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket.

ENI: an Alibaba Cloud elastic network interface.

NLB: an Alibaba Cloud NLB instance
Type.description_zh:
终端节点类型。
Domain：自定义域名。
Ip：自定义IP。
IpTarget：自定义私网IP。
PublicIp：阿里云公网IP。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。

VSwitchIds.description_en: A list of vSwitches in the VPC

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group

EndpointGroupIpList.description_en:
A list of public egress IP addresses of the endpoint group.

<notice>

For endpoint groups connected to private backend services, the console shows only the private source IP addresses, not the public ones. If the network connection type of a backend service changes (for example, from private to public), monitor the source IP addresses and update the backend service's access control list (ACL).

</notice>
EndpointGroupIpList.description_zh:
终端节点组出公网IP列表。

<notice>
私网回源类型的终端节点组在控制台仅展示私网回源地址，不再展示公网地址。如果终端节点组后端服务的网络连接类型发生变更（例如由私网变更为公网，或调整为公私网混合回源），请及时关注回源地址的变化，并同步更新后端服务的ACL列表。</notice>

items.description_en: A public egress IP address of the endpoint group
items.description_zh: 终端节点组出公网IP列表

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The ID of the region where the endpoint group is deployed
EndpointGroupRegion.description_zh: 终端节点组所属的地域ID

EndpointGroupType.description_en:
The type of the endpoint group. Valid values:

default: a default endpoint group.

virtual: a virtual endpoint group

终端节点组类型。
default：默认终端节点组。
virtual：虚拟终端节点组

EndpointIpVersion.description_en:
The IP protocol of the backend service. Valid values:

IPv4 (default): Connections to the backend service use IPv4.

IPv6: Connections to the backend service use IPv6.

ProtocolAffinity: The connection to the backend service uses the same IP protocol as the client request
EndpointIpVersion.description_zh:
后端IP地址协议。取值：  
IPv4：（默认值）：GA仅使用IPv4地址与终端节点服务通信。  
IPv6：GA仅使用IPv6地址与终端节点服务通信。  
ProtocolAffinity：GA与终端节点服务通信的IP协议与客户端请求使用的IP协议相同

EndpointPrivateIpList.description_en: A list of private IP addresses of the endpoints

HTTP1.1: HTTP/1.1

HTTP2: HTTP/2

后端服务协议版本。

HTTP2：HTTP2版本

The protocol of the backend service. Valid values:

HTTP: HTTP

HTTPS: HTTPS
EndpointRequestProtocol.description_zh:
后端服务协议。

HTTP：HTTP协议。
HTTPS：HTTPS协议

true: Health checks are enabled.

false: Health checks are disabled

是否开启了健康检查。
true：开启健康检查。
false：关闭健康检查

HealthCheckHost.description_en: The domain name used for health checks

HealthCheckIntervalSeconds.description_en: The health check interval, in seconds
HealthCheckIntervalSeconds.description_zh: 健康检查的时间间隔，单位：秒

tcp or TCP: TCP

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the instance.

This parameter is returned only if ServiceManaged is true
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Specifies whether the instance is managed. Valid values:

true: The instance is a managed instance.

false: The instance is not a managed instance
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that you can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter is returned only if ServiceManaged is true.

Your permissions to operate on a managed instance are restricted
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_en: The actions that you can perform on the managed instance
items.description_zh: 用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create: creates an instance.

Update: updates the instance.

Delete: deletes the instance.

Associate: associates the instance with other resources.

UserUnmanaged: Reverts the instance to an unmanaged state.

CreateChild: creates a child resource for the instance
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称。
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: a listener.

IpSet: an acceleration region.

EndpointGroup: an endpoint group.

ForwardingRule: a forwarding rule.

Endpoint: an endpoint.

EndpointGroupDestination: a protocol mapping for an endpoint group of a custom routing listener.

EndpointPolicy: a traffic policy for an endpoint of a custom routing listener.

This parameter is returned only if Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型。
Listener：监听资源。
IpSet：加速地域资源。
EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。
ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。
Endpoint：终端节点资源。
EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。
EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。
仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Specifies whether the action is managed. Valid values:

true: The action is managed. You cannot perform the specified action on the managed instance.

false: The action is not managed. You can perform the specified action on the managed instance
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

State.description_en:
The state of the endpoint group.

init: The endpoint group is initializing.

active: The endpoint group is stable.

updating: The endpoint group is updating.

deleting: The endpoint group is deleting
State.description_zh:
终端节点组的状态。
init：初始化。

active：正常。

updating：更新中。

deleteing：删除中

Tags.description_en: The tags attached to the endpoint group

items.description_en: A tag of the endpoint group

ThresholdCount.description_en: The number of consecutive failed health checks required to mark an endpoint as unhealthy
ThresholdCount.description_zh: 健康检查判定终端节点为不健康的次数

TrafficPercentage.description_en: The percentage of traffic routed to the endpoint group. This parameter applies only if a listener is associated with multiple endpoint groups
TrafficPercentage.description_zh: 监听有多个终端节点组时，配置到不同终端节点组的流量比例

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
